summary: Brittle provider checks loosened. Chat: finish_reason=stop beside complete tool calls is accepted in streams and JSON (tool_calls without any call is still rejected); a stream chunk without choices (usage-only/keep-alive) is skipped and a choice without index is taken as index 0 (an explicit non-zero index or more than one choice still fails). Anthropic: unknown stream event types are ignored, and unknown content_block_delta kinds (e.g. citations_delta) are ignored, while a known delta on the wrong block type still fails. Gemini: totalTokenCount only has to be >= promptTokenCount + candidatesTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount, and the reported total is kept as Usage.total_tokens.
